 When do the Black Friday fashion deals start? 
 With a lot of experience scouring the internet for the best deals , it’s safe to say we have quite a good perspective on what’s worth your time. Seeing huge red banners and endless Black Friday messaging can tempt you to impulse buy something you won’t ever wear – but end up purchasing thanks to an enticing hefty discount – which is why it’s vital to go in with a clear and considered mindset.
 Even if you’re not participating in the Black Friday clothing sales this year, this period presents a good opportunity for you to take stock of what you already have. Consider this time period a fitting moment for a wardrobe refresh, and ask yourself the following questions: is there anything that you don’t wear anymore? Can you see or think of anything you need or want? Do you have a bag full of things to be altered that you could revisit instead of buying something new?
 Read more: The Standout Buys From Mytheresa’s Black Friday Sale That Are Worth Your Attention 
 As A Beauty Editor, These Are The Best Black Friday Deals I’ve Found By Ellie Davis View Gallery If, after investigating your current wardrobe situation, you discover a legitimate gap, then the Black Friday sales will serve as a good chance for you to invest. It’s best to look to brands and retailers that you’re already familiar with, since shopping online can make it tricky to discern sizing. Most direct-to-consumer sites offer some kind of deal during this period – high-street brands like Cos and H&M are set to have site-wide price drops – while discounted luxury fashion can be found at retailers like Net-a-Porter, Mytheresa and Selfridges.

 FAQs
 When do the Black Friday fashion deals start?
 While many sales start at the beginning of November – and some even earlier in October – official Black Friday 2026 fashion deals come into effect on 27 November 2026. Some retailers such as Net-a-Porter , Boden and MyTheresa feature designated sales sections on their websites all year round, while others such as Cos align discounts with Cyber Week.
 The sales are set to stretch from the official Black Friday date of 27 November and continue into Cyber Monday on 30 November. Some retailers even offer last-chance deals in the days following. At Vogue , we’ve been trawling the sales since the start of the month, and will continue to do so throughout Cyber Week, updating this article as and when new products come in. Treat this as your cheat sheet to all the the best fashion deals throughout Cyber season.
